products.name: Connected Papers
products.note: Visual paper graph; literature discovery; academic research; Israeli vendor

profile_text.body:
Connected Papers is an Israeli software company that offers a visual tool designed to help researchers and applied scientists discover and explore academic papers relevant to their field of work. The company describes its product as a unique, visual approach to literature discovery, presenting relationships between papers in a graph format rather than a conventional list of search results.

The company's sole tracked product, also called Connected Papers, is categorized as a search and research tool. It generates visual paper graphs to help users navigate academic literature and identify works connected to a given starting paper. No litigation, patent filings, SEC disclosures, or MCP registry presence are recorded in the held facts.
